name: guido-dividend-system
description: Guido Dividend System - sistema local de inteligencia patrimonial, dividendos, B3 Ledger e FIIs.

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const must=p=>fs.existsSync(p); const read=p=>fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); const index=read('public/index.html'); const dash=read('public/dashboard.html'); const admin=read('public/admin.html'); const domain=read('public/platform/domain.js'); const portal=read('public/platform/portal.js'); const calendar=read('public/platform/calendarAnalytics.js'); const api=read('workers/platform-api/src/index.js'); const migration=read('workers/platform-api/migrations/0003_admin_data_center.sql'); const routes=['public/ativos/index.html','public/calendario/index.html','public/mapa-da-renda/index.html','public/admin/index.html','public/admin/importacoes/index.html','public/admin/brapi/index.html','public/admin/revisao/index.html','public/admin/publicacao/index.html','public/sistema/index.html','public/meu-painel/index.html','public/conta/perfil/index.html','docs/ativos/index.html','docs/platform/portal.js']; if(!index.includes('Radar de Proventos') || !index.includes('calendarAnalytics.js') || !index.includes('/sistema/') || !dash.includes('quantEngine') || !admin.includes('Central Administrativa de Proventos') || !domain.includes('PUBLIC_PORTAL_ENABLED') || !portal.includes('Central Administrativa de Proventos') || !portal.includes('Mesa operacional de proventos') || !portal.includes('Capturar evento') || !calendar.includes('opportunityScore') || !api.includes('/admin/imports/b3') || !api.includes('/public/events') || !migration.includes('canonical_financial_events') || routes.some(p=>!must(p))) process.exit(1); console.log('OK: portal, mesa operacional, central admin, API canonica e legado encontrados');"
scripts.test: node tests/plan-policy.test.mjs && node tests/portfolio-engine.test.mjs && node tests/calendar-analytics.test.mjs && node tests/admin-data-center.test.mjs && node tests/income-map-methodology.test.mjs && node tests/asset-discovery.test.mjs
scripts.admin:migrate: cd workers/admin-api && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply radar-admin-finops --remote
